title: HMD personal preferences
description: Per-user preferences stored against the account in users.json. They affect only the signed-in user.

skin.description: Typography, spacing, markers and statusline. Widgets and publishing are set per namespace; the same repository works under any skin.

palette.description: Colours only, independent of the skin. Swatches follow the current light or dark mode, chosen from the top bar.

font_ui.description: Typeface for interface text and page prose.

font_mono.description: Typeface for code blocks, the editor and other monospaced text.

git_author.description: Your commit identity, as Name <email>. Overrides the instance default author for your saves.
